summary: Vistance Networks filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, announcing that its Board declared a one-time special cash distribution of $1.50 per share, payable November 6, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business October 26, 2026. Because the distribution equals 25% or more of the common stock value, Nasdaq Rule 11140(b)(2) sets the ex-dividend date at November 9, 2026. No advisor was named, and no board recommendation beyond approval was disclosed. The company expects return-of-capital treatment for U.S. federal tax purposes, subject to earnings and profits, with Form 8937 to follow within 45 days. Watch for trading around the deferred ex-date and any leverage or liquidity implications for the capital structure.
